description: compat-es round 2: locale date formats (aggregation, docvalue and sort formats in the field locale; ingest date and date_index_name locales, TAI64N, UNIX, errors), runtime fields in bool rewrites, forced synthetic source and vectors. Also aggregate_metric_double, histogram fields, moving_percentiles, top_metrics limits, constant_keyword values and sorts, geo_grid queries.
